title: Menstrual Cycle-Associated Symptom Fluctuations in Myasthenia Gravis
summary:
Currently, little is known about how hormonal changes during the menstrual cycle affect women with Myasthenia Gravis. However, worsening of symptoms at certain times during the menstrual cycle may have a considerable impact on quality of life. In addition, changes in symptom severity may influence decisions about medical treatment.
Findings from other areas of neurological research suggest that hormonal changes during the menstrual cycle may affect symptoms in women with Myasthenia Gravis. However, this topic has not yet been sufficiently studied. The aim of this study is to improve understanding of the relationship between hormonal changes during the menstrual cycle and symptoms of Myasthenia Gravis. In particular, the study will investigate patients’ experiences as well as the severity and duration of symptoms at different stages of the menstrual cycle.
After enrollment, approximately 60 participants will take part in the study for three months. At the beginning of the study, participants will complete a detailed questionnaire about their symptoms in everyday life, emotional well-being, fatigue, symptoms before menstruation, menstrual cycle characteristics, sleep quality, personal background information, and other factors that may affect their symptoms.
Participants will then complete a short questionnaire every three days about their current symptoms, their current stage of the menstrual cycle, their current disease-related difficulties, and possible external influences.
At the end of the three-month study period, participants will complete a final questionnaire about their symptoms, menstrual cycle, sleep quality, other relevant factors, and their overall experience during the study.

interventions.name:
Prospective, single-center, single-arm study 

Inclusion criteria:
1. women aged 18–50 AND
2. with medically confirmed myasthenia gravis (MG) AND
3. with a regular menstrual cycle (frequency 21–45 days) AND
4. who are able to complete the questionnaires online over a three-month period.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Diagnosis of Myasthenia Gravis
Menstrual cycle with regular menstrual periods (21-45 days interval)
Ability to complete the questionnaires digitally
Exclusion criteria:
Pregnancy
Initiation of or change in hormonal medication within the last two months
Menstrual cycle without regular menstruation.
